title: 2026 Honors Convocation marks University Honors Program’s 70th anniversary
summary_en: The University Honors Program recognized two faculty members and a student for their contributions to the program during Honors Convocation, an annual celebration for first-year honors students, which took place Aug. 23 at the Burge Union.
title_cn: 2026 Honors Convocation marks University Honors Program’s 70th anniversary

title: Second annual Falling into AI Summit will bring experts from Google, Amazon to KU
summary_en: The University of Kansas is hosting the second annual Falling into AI Summit from Sept. 22-24, bringing together leaders from KU, KU Medical Center, Google, Amazon Web Services, Apple and artificial intelligence industry partners to explore how AI is transforming education, healthcare, research, workforce development and society.
title_cn: Second annual Falling into AI Summit will bring experts from Google, Amazon to KU

title: Fall Design Professional Lecture Series brings acclaimed artists and designers to KU
summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Architecture & Design will welcome seven accomplished artists and designers for the Fall 2026 Design Professional Lecture Series. title: ‘Nollywood’ film industry still tethered to patriarchal stereotypes despite progress of female characters, expert says
summary_en: In a new article, Abisola Akínsìkù, a doctoral candidate in English at the University of Kansas, uses feminism as a conceptual lens to interrogate how female characters are portrayed in the burgeoning “Nollywood” film industry of Nigeria.
title_cn: ‘Nollywood’ film industry still tethered to patriarchal stereotypes despite progress of female characters, expert says
